definition: Voice Mate, formerly called Quick Voice and later Q Voice, is an intelligent personal assistant and knowledge navigator which is only available as a built-in application for various LG smartphones.
details: The application uses a natural language user interface to answer questions, make recommendations, and perform actions by delegating requests to a set of Web services. It is based on the Maluuba personal assistant. Some of the capabilities of Voice Mate include making appointments, opening apps, setting alarms, updating social network websites, such as Facebook or Twitter and navigation. Voice Mate also offers efficient multitasking as well as automatic activation features, for example when the car engine is started.

explainer.lead: Voice Mate is an intelligent personal assistant built into various LG smartphones. It matters as an early example of natural-language assistants shipped as a device-native app.

tiers.eli5: It's a helper built into your phone that you talk to for answers and actions.
tiers.practitioner: It parses natural-language requests and delegates them to web services, based on the Maluuba assistant; a pitfall for such built-in assistants is dependence on external web services and limited cross-device availability.
tiers.paperLevel: It is a natural-language user interface that answers questions, makes recommendations, and performs actions by delegating requests to a set of web services. Its scope is limited to LG smartphones.

explainer.example: A user asks the phone to set an alarm or update a social network, and the assistant delegates the request to the relevant service.
